tasks.goal: Close the two post-review gaps without changing the failure taxonomy or policy. Preserve Claude result subtype as a bounded non-secret field and use a known error_max_budget_usd subtype to classify budget_exhausted/provider with code error_max_budget_usd, while explicit wall-clock timeout still outranks it. Preserve another bounded unknown subtype as a failure code without inventing a category. Tighten CostTruth parsers so provider-reported observations require currency, and an authoritative provider total requires provider source, non-null amount/currency, no amount/currency missing reasons, and observations that are empty or all provider-reported. Keep valid cli-estimated records with unknown currency non-authoritative. Add focused positive and negative tests for subtype precedence/codes and provider authority. Do not change retry, acceptance, routing, admission, queue semantics or design documents.
nonGoals: Do not modify design/failure-cost-truth-v0.md or design/failure-cost-hardening-v0.md.
Do not add automatic retry, routing, admission or parallel dispatch.
Do not make CLI estimates authoritative or claim DeepSeek billing/balance.
Do not alter RunManifest authority or queue/run acceptance.
Do not retain raw result subtypes longer than the bounded code or raw provider payloads.
